purpose: Read-only source-of-truth for 333 Network routes, browser-local continuity and future STOS service-terminal boundaries; not an authorization or deployment manifest.

governance.sourceOfAuthority: Verified source files on repository default branch; runtime status remains unverified.
governance.memberAuthority: Backend authenticated member/session only; HOLLO browser-local handoff is descriptive and never an authorization credential.
governance.adminBoundary: Administrators and STOS remain dormant; the contract grants no roles, tokens, access, or infrastructure activation.

futureSTOSPolicy.model: Dedicated STOS service-hosting terminal per subsidiary, as directed by the founder.
futureSTOSPolicy.note: STOS internals and the public application's source-of-truth are separate. Do not infer that a planned terminal is live.

routes.rule: Only these four are presently assigned; direct-link applications must not be given invented numbers.

subsidiaries.name: E=Ven Mail
subsidiaries.role: Mail address applications and local correspondence
subsidiaries.backendSourceState: member application endpoints present; delivery unverified

subsidiaries.name: Bazaar Art Live
subsidiaries.backendSourceState: member social gateway present; hosted service unverified

subsidiaries.name: Bunya
subsidiaries.backendSourceState: authenticated conditional OHMIC sync bridge; runtime unavailable/unverified

subsidiaries.name: FleaPit
subsidiaries.role: Movie and video discovery, queue and media library
subsidiaries.backendSourceState: authenticated member-library gateway present; runtime unverified

alternateImplementation.note: Preserve both entry points and local data; no automatic redirects or migration.

sourceBoundaries.publicFrontends: Static HTML and client-side data are not authentication authorities.
sourceBoundaries.backend: FastAPI routers in repository do not establish that a deployed service is live.
sourceBoundaries.ohmic: Source implementation present; upstream availability and member permissions must be independently verified.
sourceBoundaries.pwa: Static precache does not prove that all application functionality works offline.
sourceBoundaries.storage: Browser storage is scoped to origin and must not be equated with a synchronized member account.

acceptanceRules: Assigned routes must remain unique and match declared app files.
Every declared app and backend router must exist in this repository.
Every precached app must appear in the service worker.
No subsidiary may be marked as a commissioned STOS terminal by this contract.
No route or local storage handoff may grant privileged access.
The 333 directory's FleaPit external link must be explicitly recorded; no silent canonical switch.
futureTerminalDescriptors: Each subsidiary inherits governance.futureSTOSPolicy until separately commissioned, authenticated, and approved.
